intro: The rest of this wiki is generated from the pack’s own files and works offline — this page is the exception: hand-checked links to community guide creators and reference sites. The best guide videos have also been distilled into this wiki’s own pages — see Tips & Tricks, Legendaries and Mechanics, each of which credits its sources.
